title: Pop out v3
brief: Your whole closet is already in your camera roll; Curate pulls it out. For US 18–34s who have never heard of Curate. Her denim jacket lifts out of her ferry photo; the camera glides back and the photo is one of thirty in her camera roll; it glides into her market photo, the phone forms round it, and the real app lifts her Ballet Flats out of that photo; the real review screen counts to 41 pieces from her photos; the Curate lockup holds, Zee bounces, and her ferry photo comes back (a loop). Made by the motion studio process (brief.md, style_guide.md, shotlist.md): smoother and clearer than v2, one focal point per beat, 60 fps.
hook: 0–2 s: her ferry photo, big and alone; on the drop her denim jacket lifts out of it; at 0.92 s "Your closet is already in your camera roll."
disclosures: Emma is an AI-generated persona and her photos are AI-generated: turn on the platform AI label (TikTok "AI-generated content", Meta "AI info", YouTube "altered or synthetic content").
The app footage is real (Curate 1.5.0, build 262, Emma's account) at real speed: the first piece lifting out of her photo, and the review screen counting to her 41 pieces.
Music: Mixkit Stock Music Free License (Cat Walk, Arulo): online and social ads are fine; no TV/radio, never register it with Content ID.
notes: The first ad made by the motion studio process (decisions/0011, proposed). G2 and G3 approved by the founder (G3: "not quite up to the mark but would like to see the results"; open choices left at the defaults: the flat-lay jacket cut-out, the phone position as is). G4 animatic (critic rounds 7–9) and G5 full pass with designed sound (rounds 10–12) done; G5 waits for the founder's review. 6 s and 30 s cut-downs and the 4:5 / 1:1 formats are planned in brief.md, not built.
